---
title: "First Suffolk Senate: Nick Collins faces a Wu-backed primary challenge"
description: |
    Boston Mayor Michelle Wu's endorsement of Latoya Gaye sets up a high-profile
    primary challenge to incumbent Senator Nick Collins in the First Suffolk district.
author: Brent Benson
date: 2026-06-08
image: images/first-suffolk-map.png
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(formattable)

tmap_mode("view")
```

```{r}
# National two-election average (2024 + 2020) for PVI baseline
US_Harris_24 <- 75017626
US_Trump_24  <- 77301997
US_Biden_20  <- 81281502
US_Trump_20  <- 74222593
US_PVI_24 <- (US_Harris_24 + US_Biden_20) /
             (US_Harris_24 + US_Trump_24 + US_Biden_20 + US_Trump_20)

pvi_string <- function(pvi_n) {
    case_when(
        pvi_n <= -0.5 ~ str_c("R+", round(abs(pvi_n))),
        pvi_n >= 0.5  ~ str_c("D+", round(pvi_n)),
        TRUE          ~ "EVEN"
    )
}

prec_data <- read_csv(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bwbensonjr/mapoli/refs/heads/master/pvi/ma_precincts_districts_pres_2024.csv",
    show_col_types = FALSE
)

prec_demographics <- read_csv(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bwbensonjr/mapoli/refs/heads/master/demographics/data/ma_precinct_demographics.csv",
    show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
    select(
        city_town, ward, precinct, wwc_pct, race_white_pct, ed_college_degree_pct,
        total_population, race_white, race_black, race_hispanic, race_asian,
        race_multiracial
    )

first_suffolk_data <- prec_data |>
    filter(State_Senate == "First Suffolk") |>
    left_join(prec_demographics, by = c("city_town", "ward", "precinct")) |>
    filter(!is.na(wwc_pct)) |>
    mutate(
        PVI_N         = ((Harris_24 + Biden_20) /
                         (Harris_24 + Trump_24 + Biden_20 + Trump_20) - US_PVI_24) * 100,
        PVI           = pvi_string(PVI_N),
        WWC_PCT       = wwc_pct * 100,
        WWC_PCT_clamped = pmin(WWC_PCT, 30),
        WHITE_PCT     = race_white_pct * 100,
        COLLEGE_PCT   = ed_college_degree_pct * 100,
        # Mutually-exclusive race/ethnicity shares (sum ~100%); Native American,
        # Hawaiian, and Other are negligible district-wide so are omitted here.
        BLACK_PCT     = race_black / total_population * 100,
        HISP_PCT      = race_hispanic / total_population * 100,
        ASIAN_PCT     = race_asian / total_population * 100,
        MULTI_PCT     = race_multiracial / total_population * 100,
        plurality_idx = max.col(
            as.matrix(pick(WHITE_PCT, BLACK_PCT, HISP_PCT, ASIAN_PCT, MULTI_PCT)),
            ties.method = "first"
        ),
        PLURALITY = factor(
            c("White", "Black", "Hispanic", "Asian", "Multiracial")[plurality_idx],
            levels = c("White", "Black", "Hispanic", "Asian", "Multiracial")
        ),
        precinct_label = if_else(ward == "-", precinct, str_c(ward, "-", precinct))
    )
```

## White Working-Class

```{r}
#| column: body-outset
#| fig-cap: |
#|   *White working-class share of each First Suffolk precinct*

# Boston mainland boundary to clip the precinct polygons. The generalized
# coastline layer counts the harbor islands as land, but they have no voters,
# so we keep only the largest connected component (the mainland).
boston_land <- read_sf(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bwbensonjr/mapoli/refs/heads/master/gis/geojson/city_town_2024.geojson"
) |>
    filter(city_town == "Boston") |>
    st_make_valid() |>
    st_cast("POLYGON") |>
    mutate(part_area = st_area(geometry)) |>
    slice_max(part_area, n = 1) |>
    st_geometry()

first_suffolk_geom <- read_sf(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bwbensonjr/mapoli/refs/heads/master/gis/geojson/wardsprecincts2022.geojson"
) |>
    right_join(first_suffolk_data, by = c("city_town", "ward", "precinct")) |>
    st_make_valid() |>
    st_buffer(dist = 10) |>
    st_buffer(dist = -10) |>
    st_simplify(dTolerance = 25) |>
    st_intersection(boston_land) |>
    st_make_valid()

wwc_palette <- c("#FFF7EC", "#FEE8C8", "#FDD49E", "#FDBB84", "#FC8D59", "#EF6548", "#D7301F", "#990000")

district_map <- (
    tm_shape(first_suffolk_geom) +
    tm_polygons(
        fill       = "WWC_PCT_clamped",
        fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(
            values = wwc_palette,
            limits = c(0, 30),
            ticks  = c(0, 10, 20, 30),
            labels = c("0%", "10%", "20%", "30%+")
        ),
        fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "White Working\nClass %"),
        fill_alpha  = 0.7,
        popup.vars  = c(
            "Precinct"            = "precinct_label",
            "White working class" = "WWC_PCT",
            "White %"             = "WHITE_PCT",
            "College degree %"    = "COLLEGE_PCT",
            "PVI"                 = "PVI"
        )
    ) +
    tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap")
)

district_map
```

## Race and Ethnicity

```{r}
#| column: body-outset
#| fig-cap: |
#|   *Largest racial or ethnic group for each precinct*

plurality_palette <- c(
    White       = "#2166AC",
    Black       = "#238B45",
    Hispanic    = "#E6550D",
    Asian       = "#6A51A3",
    Multiracial = "#969696"
)

race_map <- (
    tm_shape(first_suffolk_geom) +
    tm_polygons(
        fill        = "PLURALITY",
        fill.scale  = tm_scale_categorical(values = plurality_palette),
        fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Largest group"),
        fill_alpha  = 0.7,
        popup.vars  = c(
            "Precinct"      = "precinct_label",
            "Largest group" = "PLURALITY",
            "White %"        = "WHITE_PCT",
            "Black %"        = "BLACK_PCT",
            "Hispanic %"     = "HISP_PCT",
            "Asian %"        = "ASIAN_PCT",
            "Multiracial %"  = "MULTI_PCT"
        )
    ) +
    tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap")
)

race_map
```
